newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 3-yr corporate bond yields close lower.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 3-yr corporate bond yields close lower.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed lower on Thursday but profit-taking late in the day wiped out part of the yields' early sharp falls, dealers said.
The three-month CD yields closed flat in slow trading.
The overnight call rate rose as short-term cash liquidity was seen tightening, dealers said.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.02 pct vs Wednesday's 12.05
* Average overnight call rate at 12.0 pct vs Wednesday's 11.5
